title.purpose: Heading of the screen where the genre tree and its aliases are edited.

tree.title.purpose: Heading of the panel with the genre tree.
tree.title.where: Genres screen, the genre tree panel.

tree.branchLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the field for a new top-level genre.
tree.branchLabel.where: Genres screen, the genre tree panel.

tree.addBranch.purpose: Button that adds the typed name as a top-level genre.
tree.addBranch.where: Genres screen, the genre tree panel.

tree.loadSeed.purpose: Button that adds the proposed starter genres to an empty tree.
tree.loadSeed.where: Genres screen, the genre tree panel.

tree.empty.purpose: Line shown while the tree has no genres.
tree.empty.where: Genres screen, the genre tree panel.

picker.choose.purpose: First choice of a genre picker before one is chosen.
picker.choose.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

details.renameLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the field holding the chosen genre's name.
details.renameLabel.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

details.rename.purpose: Button that renames the chosen genre.
details.rename.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

details.top.purpose: Choice in the Move picker for putting a genre at the top level.
details.top.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

details.moveLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the picker that moves the chosen genre under another.
details.moveLabel.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

details.childLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the field for a new genre below the chosen one.
details.childLabel.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

details.addChild.purpose: Button that adds the typed name below the chosen genre.
details.addChild.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.title.purpose: Heading of the chosen genre's alias list.
aliases.title.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.none.purpose: Line shown while the chosen genre has no aliases.
aliases.none.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.kind.folded.purpose: Says an alias matches whatever its case and accents.
aliases.kind.folded.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.kind.exact.purpose: Says an alias matches only the same text.
aliases.kind.exact.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.removeLabel.purpose: Accessible name of an alias's Remove button; {{alias}} is the alias.
aliases.removeLabel.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.remove.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.addLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the field for a new alias.
aliases.addLabel.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.kindLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the picker for how a new alias is matched.
aliases.kindLabel.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

aliases.add.purpose: Button that adds the typed alias to the chosen genre.
aliases.add.where: Genres screen, the details of the chosen genre.

spellings.title.purpose: Heading of the list of genre spellings the Library's tracks use.
spellings.title.where: Genres screen, the list of spellings from the Library.

spellings.none.purpose: Line shown when no track has a genre.
spellings.none.where: Genres screen, the list of spellings from the Library.

spelling.tracks.purpose: How many tracks have a spelling or a genre; {{n}} is the number.
spelling.tracks.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

spelling.goesTo.purpose: Says where a spelling goes and which rule sent it there; {{name}} is the genre, {{rule}} the rule's wording.
spelling.goesTo.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

spelling.pickLabel.purpose: Accessible name of the picker that chooses a genre for an unmapped spelling; {{spelling}} is the spelling.
spelling.pickLabel.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

spelling.map.purpose: Button that makes an unmapped spelling an alias of the chosen genre.
spelling.map.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

rule.exact.purpose: Rule wording: the spelling is the genre's name.
rule.exact.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

rule.folded.purpose: Rule wording: the same name once case and accents are ignored.
rule.folded.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

rule.parentSub.purpose: Rule wording: the spelling is written Parent (Sub) and Sub is below Parent.
rule.parentSub.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

rule.alias.purpose: Rule wording: an alias made by the user.
rule.alias.where: Genres screen and Review's unmapped-genre group, a genre spelling's row.

unmapped.summary.purpose: One line after the heading: how many tracks have no genre and how many spellings are unmapped.

settingsPanel.title.purpose: Heading of the Settings panel that links to the Genres screen.

unmapped.noGenre.purpose: Heading of the list of Library tracks with no genre; {{n}} is how many.

unmapped.spellings.purpose: Heading of the list of spellings no rule maps to a genre.

error.notFound.purpose: Refusal: the genre or alias is gone.
error.notFound.where: Shown when a genre edit is refused.

error.nameEmpty.purpose: Refusal: a genre or alias name is empty.
error.nameEmpty.where: Shown when a genre edit is refused.

error.nameTaken.purpose: Refusal: a genre with this name exists; {{name}} is that genre.
error.nameTaken.where: Shown when a genre edit is refused.

error.moveIntoItself.purpose: Refusal: a genre was to go inside itself or one of its own genres.
error.moveIntoItself.where: Shown when a genre edit is refused.

error.textTooLong.purpose: Refusal: a genre name or alias is over 200 characters.
error.textTooLong.where: Shown when a genre edit is refused.

error.aliasTaken.purpose: Refusal: the spelling is already a name or an alias; {{name}} is the genre it goes to.
error.aliasTaken.where: Shown when a genre edit is refused.
